Method: Possessions and efficiency are not used here, this is equities. Checks: cash conversion, accruals, receivables vs revenue, dilution, profitability, leverage, cash burn. DCF: 5 years FCF growth, WACC discount, terminal value, minus net debt, divided by shares. Evaluator: Quality, Growth, Valuation, Moat, Risk, each 1-5, total = sum / 25 x 100. Bullshit checker is a veto, a RED flag does not change a score, it blocks a Buy on its own.
